3.1.1 The unit shall detect a 1 square meter radar cross-section target at a minimum range of 45 kilometers
under clear-weather conditions.
3.1.2 The unit shall complete a full 360-degree azimuth scan in no more than 4 seconds.
3.1.3 The unit shall achieve a range resolution of 15 meters or better.
3.1.4 The unit shall operate continuously for 500 hours between scheduled maintenance actions.

3.2.1 The unit shall operate within an ambient temperature range of -45°C to 71°C without degradation in
performance (reference: MIL-STD-810H, Method 501.7 and 502.7).

3.2.2 The unit shall withstand random vibration testing for a minimum duration of 2 hours per axis, per
MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8, Category 4 (equipment category: ground, mobile).

3.2.3 The unit shall function at altitudes up to 6000 meters above mean sea level per MIL-STD-810H Method
500.6.
3.2.4 The unit shall meet IP65 ingress protection rating for dust and water resistance.

3.3.1 The unit shall operate from a nominal 28 VDC supply and shall tolerate transients up to 60 V without
damage, per MIL-STD-461G, CS116.

3.3.2 The unit shall not exceed 850 W average power consumption in Mode 1 (search) and 1200 W in Mode 2
(track).
3.3.3 The unit shall limit conducted emissions per MIL-STD-461G, CE102, across the 10 kHz to 10 MHz band.

3.4.1 The unit shall provide an emergency stop control that removes all RF transmission within 200
milliseconds of activation, per MIL-STD-882E hazard mitigation guidance.

3.4.2 The unit shall not present an electric shock hazard exceeding the limits of MIL-STD-882E, Table III,
Severity Category II.

3.4.3 The unit shall include interlocks that prevent high-voltage access panels from being opened while the
transmitter is energized.
3.5.1 The unit shall provide a MIL-STD-1553B data bus interface for command and telemetry.
3.5.2 The unit shall provide a 10/100BASE-T Ethernet maintenance port, connector type P/N 7741-0032.
3.5.3 The unit shall not exceed a total mass of 35.5 kg including mounting hardware.
3.5.4 The unit shall provide a visual BITE (built-in test equipment) status indicator visible from 3 meters.
3.6.1 The unit shall achieve a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of no less than 2,000 hours.

3.6.2 The unit shall achieve a Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) of no more than 30 minutes for line-replaceable
unit swaps.

4.1 All requirements in Section 3 shall be verified by test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration as recorded
in the associated test report.
